paragraphs.text: Jimak Ravelth was the Master of the Purple House of Ingkara , in the city of Estark on Dominaria . He participated in the Night of Fire , the destruction of the House of Oor-tael .

Jimak had a lean, angular body, dressed with a purple robe made of the richest velvet and covered with heavy rope-like coils of gold embroidery. He had a waspy, angular face with bloodless lips. Jimak valued gold and gems above everything and thus was easily bribed.

At the end of the Time of Troubles , when Zarel attacked the other Houses, he bribed Jimak to betray the other houses and side with him. After the battle, in a last act of defiance, he hid his spells and committed suicide by poison, robbing Zarel of the last victory.
